resources.name: HandsOn Charlotte
resources.description: Charlotte's volunteer matching hub. High school students can find one-day service projects, ongoing volunteer roles, and group opportunities at food pantries, parks, and nonprofits.

resources.name: YMCA of Greater Charlotte – Teen Programs
resources.description: Teen clubs, leadership, lifeguard training, camp counselor-in-training, and volunteer roles at YMCA branches across Mecklenburg County. Many sites hire teens 15+.

resources.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Charlotte
resources.description: After-school and summer clubs for students. Teens can join, tutor younger members, or volunteer as junior staff at clubhouses across Charlotte.

resources.name: Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Central Piedmont
resources.description: Mentoring for youth. High school students 16+ can apply as mentors in some programs; younger students can be matched with an adult mentor for support.

resources.name: Junior Achievement of Central Carolinas
resources.description: Work-readiness, financial literacy, and entrepreneurship programs in CMS schools. Teens can volunteer as JA student ambassadors and explore business internships.

resources.name: Charlotte Works Youth Services
resources.description: Workforce board serving Mecklenburg. Helps teens and young adults find jobs, internships, job-readiness workshops, and paid work experience.

resources.name: City of Charlotte Mayor's Youth Employment Program
resources.description: Paid summer jobs and internships for Charlotte high school students with city departments and partner employers. Apply through the City of Charlotte youth employment page.

resources.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools CTE Internships
resources.description: Career and Technical Education internships and work-based learning through CMS high schools. Ask your CTE teacher or counselor about internships in health, IT, trades, and business.

resources.name: Central Piedmont Career & College Promise
resources.description: Tuition-free college classes and career certificates for eligible CMS high school students. A real path to dual enrollment, internships, and job skills before graduation.

resources.name: CFNC – College Foundation of North Carolina
resources.description: Free statewide help for FAFSA, scholarships, college applications, and career planning. Built for high school students and families in North Carolina.

resources.name: Foundation For The Carolinas Scholarships
resources.description: Local scholarship portal for Charlotte-Mecklenburg students. Search and apply for community scholarships in one place.

resources.name: Bank of America Student Leaders
resources.description: Paid summer internship for rising high school seniors with a local nonprofit plus a leadership summit. Competitive, real work experience in Charlotte.

resources.name: Urban League of Central Carolinas
resources.description: Job training, youth leadership, and career programs for Charlotte students and young adults. Contact them about internships and summer work.

resources.name: YWCA Central Carolinas
resources.description: Youth development, racial justice programs, and volunteer opportunities. Teens can tutor, help at events, or join leadership programs.

resources.name: Right Moves for Youth
resources.description: In-school support, mentoring, and college/career coaching for CMS students. A trusted Charlotte program for teens who want extra support to graduate and plan next steps.

resources.name: Teen Health Connection
resources.description: Adolescent medical care, counseling, and health education for Charlotte teens. Confidential-friendly clinic connected to Atrium Health Levine Children's.

resources.name: Mental Health America of Central Carolinas
resources.description: Local mental health education, screening, and referrals. Teens can find help and also volunteer for awareness events.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free, confidential 24/7 support if you or a friend are in crisis. Call or text 988. For Charlotte teens who need help right now.

resources.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Library – Teen Volunteer
resources.description: Volunteer at ImaginOn and branch libraries: homework help, summer reading, teen advisory boards, and event support. A strong resume volunteer role.

resources.name: ImaginOn: The Joe & Joan Martin Center
resources.description: Library + children's theater downtown. Teens volunteer with performances, camps, and youth programs, or use the space to study and create.

resources.name: Discovery Place Science
resources.description: Museum volunteer and teen intern-style roles (floor interpreter, camps, events). Great for students interested in STEM.

resources.name: Mint Museum
resources.description: Art museum volunteer and teen intern opportunities at Mint Museum Uptown and Randolph. Apply through the museum volunteer page.

resources.name: Harvey B. Gantt Center
resources.description: African American arts and culture museum. Student volunteers and internships in education, events, and guest services.

resources.name: Levine Museum of the New South
resources.description: Charlotte history museum. Teens can volunteer as gallery guides, help with education programs, or apply for museum internships.

resources.name: Carolina Raptor Center
resources.description: Wildlife center in Huntersville. High school volunteers help with education programs and grounds. Strong fit for students interested in animals or environmental science.

resources.name: Humane Society of Charlotte
resources.description: Animal shelter volunteer roles for teens (age minimums apply). Dog walking, cat care, events, and adoption support.
resources.hours: See website for teen volunteer ages

resources.name: American Red Cross Greater Carolinas
resources.description: Disaster response, blood drives, and youth Red Cross clubs. High school students can volunteer, take first aid/CPR, and join leadership programs.

resources.name: Atrium Health Volunteer Services
resources.description: Hospital volunteer program. Many sites accept teens 16+ (some 18+). Strong for students exploring nursing, pre-med, or patient care.

resources.name: Novant Health Volunteer Services
resources.description: Hospital and clinic volunteer roles in the Charlotte region. Check age requirements and apply through Novant volunteer services.

resources.name: Mecklenburg County Park and Recreation Volunteers
resources.description: Trail days, rec centers, youth sports, and nature programs. Easy local volunteer hours for students.

resources.name: U.S. National Whitewater Center
resources.description: Outdoor center west of Charlotte. Volunteer and seasonal youth employment in outdoor rec, events, and environmental programs.

resources.name: Blumenthal Performing Arts
resources.description: Usher and event volunteer roles at Belk Theater and other downtown venues. Good for students interested in arts and hospitality.

resources.name: Charlotte Ballet
resources.description: Education and performance volunteers. Teens interested in dance can help with camps, productions, and community programs.

resources.name: Council for Children's Rights
resources.description: Advocates for children and teens in Mecklenburg County. Volunteer, internship, and help resources for youth involved with schools, courts, or foster care.

resources.name: A Child's Place
resources.description: Supports children and teens experiencing homelessness in CMS. Volunteer tutoring, mentoring, and donation drives.

resources.name: Pat's Place Child Advocacy Center
resources.description: Support for children and teens who have experienced abuse. Volunteer and professional internships; crisis help for families.

resources.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Explorers
resources.description: Explorer post for teens interested in public safety. Learn skills, volunteer at events, and explore law enforcement careers.

resources.name: NC 211
resources.description: Call or text 211 anytime for free help finding food, housing, health care, and youth programs in Mecklenburg County.

resources.name: Johnson C. Smith University Upward Bound
resources.description: College-prep program for eligible high school students: tutoring, campus visits, and summer academy on JCSU's campus.

resources.name: UNC Charlotte Youth & Pre-College Programs
resources.description: Summer camps, dual enrollment, and pre-college programs on UNC Charlotte's campus. Look for STEM, writing, and leadership tracks for high schoolers.

resources.name: Communities In Schools of Charlotte-Mecklenburg
resources.description: Site coordinators inside CMS schools connect students to tutoring, food, clothes, mentoring, and college help. Ask your counselor how to get connected — or volunteer.

resources.name: Goodwill Career Centers – Teen Job Help
resources.description: Free resume help, interview practice, and job search. High school students can use career centers and also volunteer or apply for youth employment programs.

resources.name: Habitat for Humanity Charlotte Region – Youth Volunteer
resources.description: Build days and ReStore volunteer shifts. High school groups and 16+ volunteers help with housing in Charlotte.

resources.name: Second Harvest Food Bank of Metrolina – Volunteer
resources.description: Sort food, pack boxes, and help distributions. One of the easiest high-impact volunteer sites for Charlotte teens and school groups.

resources.name: Crisis Assistance Ministry – Volunteer
resources.description: Help neighbors facing eviction or utility shutoff. Volunteer in the Choice Pantry, donations, or client support (age rules apply).

resources.name: Friendship Trays – Volunteer
resources.description: Deliver meals to homebound neighbors. Teens can volunteer with a parent or as a group — a classic Charlotte service hours option.

resources.name: Nourish Up – Volunteer & Help
resources.description: Food pantry network, Meals on Wheels, and volunteer packing. Students can get groceries for their family and also volunteer.

resources.name: Latin American Coalition – Youth & Volunteer
resources.description: Support for Latino students and families: education, immigration help, and youth leadership. Teens can get help or volunteer.

resources.name: International House Charlotte – Youth Programs
resources.description: Language, culture, and newcomer support. Immigrant and refugee teens can find tutoring, conversation partners, and volunteer roles.

resources.name: Time Out Youth Center
resources.description: Safe space, counseling, and support groups for LGBTQ+ youth in Charlotte. Volunteers and drop-in help for teens.

resources.name: The Relatives Youth Crisis Center
resources.description: 24/7 crisis line, emergency shelter, and counseling for youth 7–24. If you need a safe place tonight, call. Volunteer and intern roles also listed online.

resources.name: Safe Alliance – Youth & Volunteer
resources.description: 24/7 crisis line for dating violence and sexual assault. Teens can get confidential help. Older students can train as volunteers.

resources.name: Roof Above – Volunteer
resources.description: Serve meals, help at the Resource Center, and support neighbors experiencing homelessness. Group and teen volunteer options.

resources.name: Salvation Army of Greater Charlotte – Youth & Volunteer
resources.description: After-school programs, emergency assistance, and volunteer roles. Students can get help or serve at the corps and social services site.

resources.name: Classroom Central – Volunteer
resources.description: Free school supplies for CMS students in need — and a high-volume volunteer warehouse. Perfect for service hours and teacher support.

resources.name: Ada Jenkins Center – Youth Programs
resources.description: Davidson community center with youth programs, food help, and volunteer opportunities for northern Mecklenburg students.

resources.name: StepUp Ministry – Youth & Jobs
resources.description: Job training and life-skills coaching. Older teens and young adults can get career help; others can volunteer.

resources.name: GenerationNation
resources.description: Charlotte civic education nonprofit. High school students can join youth councils, election programs, and internships that teach how local government actually works.

resources.name: Heart Math Tutoring
resources.description: Volunteer as a math tutor in CMS elementary schools. High school students (age rules apply) can earn service hours by helping younger kids one-on-one.

resources.name: Freedom School Partners
resources.description: Summer literacy Freedom Schools in Charlotte. Teens can volunteer, intern as servant-leader interns (often paid/stipend), or attend as scholars.

resources.name: 100 Black Men of Greater Charlotte
resources.description: Mentoring, STEM, and college-readiness for young men in Charlotte. Students can be mentees or help at events as they get older.

resources.name: Girl Scouts Hornets' Nest Council
resources.description: Troop leadership, Gold Award service projects, and teen travel. High school Girl Scouts can also volunteer as program aides.

resources.name: Scouting America Mecklenburg County Council
resources.description: Scouts BSA, Venturing, and Explorers in Mecklenburg. High schoolers lead troops, earn Eagle/Summit, and volunteer at camporees and service days.

resources.name: Children's Theatre of Charlotte
resources.description: Usher, help with education programs, or apply for teen internships at one of the country's largest children's theatres (ImaginOn).

resources.name: Bechtler Museum of Modern Art
resources.description: Uptown modern art museum. Student volunteers and internships in visitor services, education, and events.

resources.name: NASCAR Hall of Fame
resources.description: Museum volunteer and guest-services roles downtown. Strong fit for students interested in sports, hospitality, or history.
resources.address: 400 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28202

resources.name: Ronald McDonald House Charities of Greater Charlotte
resources.description: Help families with kids in the hospital: meal programs, house support, and events. Age minimums apply; many roles start at 16 with an adult.

resources.name: Charlotte Rescue Mission
resources.description: Serve meals and support recovery programs. Group and teen volunteer options; people in crisis can also get help here.

resources.name: Loaves & Fishes
resources.description: Emergency groceries through neighborhood pantries across Charlotte. Students can volunteer at a pantry near home or get food for their family with no referral.

resources.name: Charlotte Family Housing
resources.description: Housing and coaching for families experiencing homelessness. Volunteer, intern, or get connected if your family needs stable housing.

resources.name: Charlotte Center for Legal Advocacy
resources.description: Free civil legal help for low-income people in Charlotte: housing, benefits, immigration, and more. High school internships and volunteer roles are posted when open.

resources.name: Legal Aid of North Carolina – Charlotte
resources.description: Statewide legal aid with a Charlotte office. Call if your family needs help with housing, domestic violence, or public benefits.

resources.name: Camino Community Center
resources.description: Bilingual clinic, food, and youth programs in west Charlotte. Teens can get care, join youth programs, or volunteer.

resources.name: Charlotte Community Health Clinic
resources.description: Affordable primary care for people without insurance. High school students can go for care and older students can ask about volunteer or pre-health internships.

resources.name: Care Ring
resources.description: Low-cost medical and dental care in Charlotte. A real option if you need a checkup and don't have a regular doctor.

resources.name: Anuvia Prevention and Recovery Center
resources.description: Substance-use prevention, counseling, and teen programs. Get help for yourself or a friend, or volunteer for prevention events.

resources.name: Alexander Youth Network
resources.description: Mental health treatment for children and teens in Charlotte. Counseling, crisis support, and community programs. Older students can explore internships in behavioral health.

resources.name: Thompson Child & Family Focus
resources.description: Foster care, counseling, and education for kids and teens. Volunteer, intern in social work/education, or get family support.

resources.name: Sustain Charlotte
resources.description: Local sustainability nonprofit. High school and college internships in transportation, climate, and community engagement. Real resume experience.

resources.name: TreesCharlotte
resources.description: Tree planting and canopy programs across the city. Saturday plantings are one of the easiest group volunteer options for clubs and sports teams.

resources.name: Catawba Lands Conservancy
resources.description: Land and trail stewardship in the Charlotte region. Volunteer on trail days or apply for conservation internships.

resources.name: Special Olympics Mecklenburg County
resources.description: Coach, cheer, and volunteer at competitions for athletes with intellectual disabilities. High school Unified Champion Schools and weekend events.

resources.name: Best Buddies North Carolina
resources.description: Friendship and inclusion programs with students who have intellectual and developmental disabilities. Start a chapter at your high school or volunteer at events.
resources.address: North Carolina programs, Charlotte chapters welcome

resources.name: The Arc of Mecklenburg County
resources.description: Advocacy and programs for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Volunteer, intern, or get family resources.

resources.name: Arts & Science Council
resources.description: Charlotte's arts funder. Watch for student internships, Cultural On-Call volunteer ushers, and scholarships for young artists.

resources.name: Mecklenburg County Public Health
resources.description: Immunizations, teen clinic services, WIC, and school health. Call for appointments. Pre-health students can ask about volunteer or intern pathways.

resources.name: NCWorks Career Center – Charlotte
resources.description: Free job search, resume help, and hiring events. High school students 16+ can get work-based learning info and summer job leads.

resources.name: CMS Foundation
resources.description: Scholarships, classroom grants, and student support for Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools. Search current scholarships for CMS high schoolers.

resources.name: Levine Jewish Community Center
resources.description: Teen programs, camp counselor-in-training, lifeguard jobs, and volunteer roles at the Shalom Park campus.

resources.name: Civil Air Patrol – Charlotte Composite Squadron
resources.description: US Air Force auxiliary cadet program. Aerospace education, emergency services, and leadership for teens 12–18. Weekly meetings; real community service hours.

resources.name: Mecklenburg County Animal Care & Control Volunteer
resources.description: County shelter volunteer program for dog walking, cat care, and events. Check the age minimum and orientation dates before you apply.

resources.name: Carolina Refugee Resettlement Agency
resources.description: Help newcomer families in Charlotte: tutoring, donation drives, and welcome teams. Strong volunteer hours and a real way to use a second language.

resources.name: Catholic Charities Diocese of Charlotte
resources.description: Food, immigration legal help, counseling, and family support. Open to people of all faiths. Volunteer or get assistance.

resources.name: Matthews Help Center
resources.description: Food pantry, financial help, and volunteer shifts for southeast Mecklenburg and Matthews students.

resources.name: Charlotte Museum of History
resources.description: Local history museum volunteer and intern roles in tours, archives, and education. Good for students who like history or teaching.

resources.name: Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden
resources.description: Belmont garden (easy drive from west Charlotte). Teen volunteer and seasonal internships in horticulture and education.
resources.address: 6500 S New Hope Road, Belmont, NC 28012

resources.name: Year Up Charlotte
resources.description: Job training plus a corporate internship for young adults. Most tracks start at 18; rising seniors should look now so they can apply after graduation.

resources.name: Dress for Success Charlotte
resources.description: Interview clothes and career coaching. High school students can volunteer at the boutique; older students and families can get interview help.

resources.name: RAIN of North Carolina
resources.description: HIV/STI education, testing, and support in Charlotte. Confidential help for teens, plus volunteer and intern roles in public health.

resources.name: Crossnore Communities for Children
resources.description: Foster care and residential support with a Charlotte presence. Volunteer, intern in social work, or get family resources.

resources.name: Mecklenburg County Park and Recreation Teen Employment
resources.description: Seasonal rec-center, camp, and aquatics jobs for teens (lifeguard, camp counselor, scorekeeper). Apply through the county jobs portal.

resources.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Library Homework Help
resources.description: Free tutoring, databases, and college/career help at every branch. Use it yourself, then volunteer as a teen tutor when you are ready.
